release_semantics: Helper samples all actual release states LOW and initialization at consumer edge after raw rst releases. Receiver synchronous state initializes while old live is LOW on that edge. ACK rises on a later consumer edge after all states/live are HIGH; no fixed delay counter. Raw rst pulse asynchronously invalidates epoch witness even with stopped consumer clock.
default_behavior: Undefined macro: no new ports or ACK state; shared rstsync RESET_ACK defaults0 even with macro defined.
payload_policy: Unreset payload/SRAM contents remain uninitialized; valid/control reset governs use. ACK does not promise initialized SRAM or payload bits.
physical_qualification: OPEN: new ACK child interfaces/state require successor views; old CLOSED stands.
